verdict: Persisted mouse actions verified locally; 180-second startup-readiness target missed. No seamless/cloud/whole-game qualification.

implementation.coordinates: Absolute original guest-frame x,y; no delta movement introduced. Expected width/height checked; runtime frame/mode IDs captured fresh per execution. Native replies use DOS-driver logical coordinates under the existing conversion.
implementation.persistence: Immutable source/version/parent-bound records in the same Project DB; explicit revision selection; legacy keyboard formats and IDs preserved.
implementation.mouse_action_scope: Exactly one click per named mouse action; keyboard-only sequences remain supported.
implementation.transaction: One bounded serialized act request validates running agent ownership, pauses, captures a fresh frame, checks dimensions, sends a generation-guarded absolute click, verifies its pause boundary and issues one continue.
implementation.failure_semantics: No replay or blind resume on uncertain partial effects, unexpected stop or ownership change.
implementation.deadline: Four-second shared mouse RPC deadline; native execution RPCs depend on the single-controller contract, while click injection is generation guarded.
implementation.timing_semantics: Coordination event timestamps expose request/acknowledgment brackets. Continue acknowledgment is asynchronous; resume_observed and transition_verified remain false until separately observed.
implementation.source_scope: Required persistent-play runtime foundation and native ownership overlay included; unrelated lead AGI/overlay development remains separate.

skill_changes.before_effects: Record run start, an explicit default 180-second budget/deadline and readiness condition before launch or input.
skill_changes.markers: Record launches before process creation, frame/input/effect and readiness or budget-expired events; include model/dispatch/tool/authoring time. Keep setup and configured launch distinct without dropping the whole timeline.
skill_changes.interruption_policy: Record failures, coordination and observation gaps; never infer zero or reconstruct absent starts from mtimes.
skill_changes.operation_guide: Small documented CLI path for immutable absolute mouse controls avoids private action wrappers.

validation.full_suite: 185 passed, zero skips, 14.31 s after device reconnect. Includes prepared native executable and pinned overlay-source checks.
validation.independent_code_review: No actionable defect found; mocked adapter coverage limits retained.
validation.source_after_reconnect: Frozen source hashes match; Git fsck completed without errors; native/media hashes reverified.
validation.skill_structure: Validator passed; local Markdown reference targets checked.
validation.wheel: Tool wheel built, 13 entries; backend/harness bytes match frozen source; no native binary or game data. Not full offline/cloud qualification.

runtime.model: gpt-6.1-terra; fresh local context selected by coordinator
runtime.source: Frozen implementation commit above with prepared fDisBull core/backend
runtime.target: User-supplied original Dune CD edition, new private game layout and project
runtime.exposure: No prior Dune results, frames, controllers or coordinates supplied to the fresh agent. Supplied README.DOC installation information was consulted; generic pretraining/franchise knowledge cannot be excluded. No clean-room claim.
runtime.policy: Ordinary game input; no hidden-state/source recovery or walkthrough. Serial single-owner run; no worker overlap or human takeover in this retest.

observed_transitions: Opening room to character close-up: select_duke
completed_trial.unverified_reason: Accepted inputs and cursor/menu changes do not establish conversation content or intended effects.
completed_trial.readback: New CLI clients list/read retained revisions; all five rows, hashes, bindings and parents validate across two derived read-only DB connections.
completed_trial.scope: Real persisted DotBox controls, with no private mouse-action sidecars. Expected dimensions are checked; full scene recognition and game semantics are not inferred.

startup_seconds.notes: Coordinator origin precedes delegation. Captured frame-response times are observable bounds, not exact game transition instants. Initial setup, model/dispatch and observation delays are included in full elapsed totals; configured launch is separate.

preparation_budget.start: Agent run_start, 38.339 s after coordinator origin
preparation_budget.assessment: Action acceptance before deadline did not establish readiness. Budget miss was recorded and play continued with the saved working subset; no deadline reset. Exact usable-buffer time remains unestablished.

interruptions.metric: Internal pause_requested to resume_acknowledged coordination bracket
interruptions.limits: Asynchronous acknowledgment is not exact guest resumption or a rigorous paused-time upper bound. Model inspection, scene authoring, sampled observations and gameplay waits are not a complete blocked-player timeline. Later advancing frame IDs establish subsequent guest advancement.
command_errors: Close request after already-removed first-session descriptor
interruptions.comparison: Earlier manual/sidecar trial had different actions and measurement boundaries. These are observed coordination costs, not a controlled speedup claim.

interrupted_trial_preserved.cause: External devices disappeared during execution; no replay attempted.
interrupted_trial_preserved.raw_preservation: 85 durable files copied and hashed before derived SQLite analysis.
interrupted_trial_preserved.final_action: No durable fifth act packet or frame14+; acceptance/effect remain unverified.
interrupted_trial_preserved.source_originals: Unchanged; interrupted raw data never reopened for mutation.
interrupted_trial_preserved.qualification: Retained partial evidence; not counted as a completed trial or a storage-durability guarantee.

independent_verification.coordinator: Original hall/close-up/return/map images inspected; manifest hashes, five action packets, absolute-coordinate definitions, source/media identity and timing aggregates checked. Six original game-file hashes match intake.
independent_verification.second_reviewer: Raw event/packet timing recomputed; same owner/run/generation and fresh-frame IDs verified; derived database integrity/digests/definitions/bindings/parents checked without modifying raw data.

cleanup.final_close: Acknowledged; both session descriptors absent. No process matching this trial remained at coordinator check.
cleanup.process_exit_status: Agent reports both owner command sessions exited 0; the command journal records the close-client result rather than independent owner exit status.

remaining_limits: 180-second readiness target missed; no automatic timer forced an on-time expiry event.
No exact all-user-visible interruption total or exact guest-paused time.
No actual cloud, platform takeover, native Z-scene recognition, warm guest-state persistence, dialogue-content or later-mission qualification.
One bounded fresh-model trial is not a general model benchmark.
publication: Only authored contracts, scoped measurements and hashes. Original games, frames, saves, databases, private endpoints and credentials remain outside Git.
